payout_quote: With more than 425,000 Taskers across 27 states, find workers near you.
steps: Download the Hyer app and create a Tasker profile.
Complete the mandatory Checkr background check (criminal records, sex offender registry, watch lists).
Browse posted tasks (warehouse, retail, grocery, hospitality) in your area.
Get selected by businesses posting tasks and accept the work.
Complete the task and get paid; businesses set their own hourly/task rates.
catches: Businesses choose which Taskers to select — you compete for every task and nothing is guaranteed.
Task rates are set by the posting business; Hyer applies its markup on top.
Mandatory background check before you can work.
Coverage is limited to 27 states — outside them there is no work.
Official worker-side documentation is thin; the flow is mostly documented from the business side.
biggest_catch: Businesses pick the Taskers: you can be fully onboarded and still get zero tasks if nobody selects you.
eligibility: Taskers must pass a Checkr background check; available in 27 served states.
timing: Tasks post continuously in served markets; paid per completed task.

c1.evidence: Hyer's own site documents the two-sided mechanism: businesses 'post tasks and get Taskers when you need them' and select Taskers by profile; 'customers have the flexibility and control to set their own hourly/task rates.'

c2.evidence: Official terms publish no fixed Tasker payout range — rates are business-set; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the documented flow: Tasker profile, background check, business selection, task completion, paid.

c4.evidence: No sign-up fees documented ('No sign-up fees, contracts, minimums').

s1.note: Eligibility is passing the background check in a served state.

s2.note: Framed as variable business-set task rates; no fixed amount promised.

s3.note: Catches cover selection competition, background check, and limited state coverage.

s4.note: Deduped: no Hyer route in qa/existing-providers.txt, dedupe-check.py, or qa/verification/*.json.
